title: Head P&O Policies and Risk
description:
**Job Description Summary**

The Head P\&O Policies and Risks is responsible for establishing, governing, and continuously strengthening the global P\&O policy framework, P\&O risk management approach, P\&O internal control environment, and P\&O crisis and business continuity readiness. It serves as a strategic partner to P\&O by providing oversight, guidance, and assurance on people policies, risk mitigation, and operational resilience, including effective collaboration with related enterprise\-wide corporate functions.
**Job Description**

**Position Purpose:**

The Head P\&O Policies and Risks is responsible for establishing, governing, and continuously strengthening the global P\&O policy framework, P\&O risk management approach, P\&O internal control environment, and P\&O crisis and business continuity readiness. It serves as a strategic partner to P\&O by providing oversight, guidance, and assurance on people policies, risk mitigation, and operational resilience, including effective collaboration with related enterprise\-wide corporate functions.


**Your Key Responsibilities:**

**Your responsibilities include, but not limited to**

* **Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement \& Continuous Improvement** : Provide leadership, frameworks, and decision ‑ making support to the P\&O function on policies \& guidelines, controls and risk ‑ related topics, initiatives, and projects. Ensure accessible communication of policies, risk \& resilience, controls expectations, supported by training and learning opportunities. Drive a culture of collaboration, compliance ownership, risk awareness and effective management across the P\&O community to ensure audit readiness. Monitor regulatory and organizational changes and ensure timely updates to frameworks and processes. Provide regular management reporting on the P\&O policies \& guidelines, risk \& resilience, controls KPIs and progress status.
* **P\&O Policy Governance:** Own and maintain the global P\&O policies \& guidelines framework, ensuring alignment with legal and compliance requirements and enterprise expectations. Advise P\&O policy owners on standards, requirements, and best practices in policy development and maintenance, ensuring global consistency and compliance. Oversee policy approvals, publishing, communication, and maintenance of changes track. Partner with Legal \& Compliance, and business leaders to ensure P\&O policies \& guidelines consistency across the enterprise approach.
* **P\&O Risk Management:** Lead the identification, assessment, and mitigation of P\&O risks annual cycle in collaboration with the Enterprise Risk Management team. Maintain the P\&O risk register and ensure alignment with the broader Enterprise Risk Management approach. Support P\&O teams in identifying, analysing, evaluating, and mitigating risks, including monitoring emerging risks. Conduct risk assessments, scenario analyses, and support in internal and external audits as necessary. Promote a proactive risk management culture throughout broader P\&O to ensure audit readiness.
* Internal Controls: Manage and continuously improve the P\&O internal controls framework in collaboration with Internal Controls team and relevant P\&O stakeholders. Ensure the necessary risk\-based controls are designed and embedded into the processes. Monitor the ongoing review of controls testing cycle and controls effectiveness status and ensure relevant reporting to P\&O stakeholders.
* **Crisis Management \& Business Continuity:** Lead P\&O crisis management and business continuity efforts in line with Enterprise Business Continuity and Crisis Management approach. Act as the global P\&O contact point with Corporate Security, Legal, and Crisis Management teams. Coordinate and provide necessary guidance to the country crisis teams from the global P\&O. Ensure readiness for operational disruptions through development, testing, and continuous enhancement of P\&O business continuity plans. Capture lessons learned from incidents and incorporated them into improved resilience and control processes.
* Any other accountability as assigned by direct manager.

**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* Master’s degree or adequate equivalent in law, compliance, risk management, audit, human resources or related discipline required. Project management certification, relevant Audit Qualifications desirable. 10\+ years of relevant work experience, partnering with leadership teams.
* Working with executive leadership teams in multinational companies. Designing and implementing frameworks and operating models. Experience defining and establishing policies \& guidelines requirements for a global company. Audit, compliance, quality assurance, risk management, internal controls experience, ideally with exposure to P\&O, payroll areas.
* Demonstrated understanding of P\&O processes and compliance standards. Desirable experience with different P\&O systems. Crisis and Business continuity management experience. People management and team leadership experience
* Ability to influence and partner with senior stakeholders to create joint value. Comfort independently operating in complex, matrixed, geographically dispersed, evolving and multinational environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong ethical compass. Ability to simplify complex topics and proactively drive practical implementation globally for continuous improvement. Exceptional analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving abilities

**Why Sandoz?**

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.


With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.


Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!


Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.


**Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion:**

We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.


**Skills Desired**

Knowledge Of All Relevant Policies And Practices, Knowledge Of The Hr Strategy, Organization Change, P\&O Data Analytics, Performance Management

title: Global Inclusion Lead
description:
Job Description:
**Global Inclusion Lead****Location: Flexible / Global**  

**Travel: \~10%**  

At Schneider Electric, we are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best.  

  

The **Global Inclusion Lead** shapes and delivers Schneider Electric’s global inclusion strategy, embedding inclusion “by design” into how we lead, hire, develop, and recognize talent. You’ll operate in a highly matrixed, international environment—working across cultures, functions, and time zones—to drive measurable progress and strengthen our impact internally and externally as part of our Inclusion and Care By Design strategy.  

  

**Reporting line**  

This role reports to the Inclusion and Care VP within the Global Talent, Inclusion and Culture team.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

* **Lead Global Inclusion Strategy**


Design and implement Schneider Electric’s inclusion strategy to advance equal chances of success at every level, aligned with business priorities internally and externally. Focus areas may include gender equity, race and ethnicity, LGBTQ\+ inclusion, inclusive leadership, and other locally relevant dimensions of diversity.  

  

* **Hardwire Inclusion into Processes and Behaviors**


Integrate inclusive practices into talent management, recruitment, performance development, and leadership development. Develop policies and practical toolkits that build awareness, capability, and accountability for inclusion across all levels, in close partnership with Care By Design.  

  

* **Lead the Global Gender Equity Strategy (Pipeline \+ Environment)**


Lead Schneider Electric’s global gender equity strategy to strengthen an inclusive, caring environment for women and improve outcomes across the end\-to\-end pipeline.  

Own progress on the Schneider Sustainability Impact (SSI) ambition of 40% women in leadership roles (currently 32%), translating the ambition into measurable milestones and business\-relevant actions.  

Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify where outcomes diverge across processes or parts of the organization (e.g., hiring, progression, performance development, retention), and partner with leaders to address root challenges.  

Build senior\-stakeholder alignment across HR, business leaders, and key communities to mobilize coordinated action and sustained accountability.  

  

* **Governance, Reporting \& Measurement**


Establish governance frameworks, track progress, and report on key metrics to ensure transparency and continuous improvement. Lead inclusion\-related reporting inputs for the Schneider Sustainability Impact (SSI), CSRD, the Annual report, and other corporate compliance and reporting requirements. You will have the opportunity to present to HR leadership.  

  

* **Build and Manage External Partnerships**


Act as a global ambassador for inclusion, engaging with organizations such as UN Women, WBCSD, and WEF, and managing strategic partnerships.  

  

* **Collaborate on Communications**


Work closely with internal and external Communications teams to deliver impactful messaging and storytelling on inclusion.  

  

* **How You’ll Work (Intercultural \+ Time Zones)**


Collaborate with teams and senior stakeholders across regions, cultures, and functions.  

Facilitate dialogue across different communication norms and decision\-making styles.  

Plan and run global meetings across time zones, using clear pre\-reads, inclusive facilitation, and follow\-through to keep momentum.  

  

**Key stakeholders and partnerships**  

You will build strong working relationships across a broad stakeholder ecosystem, including:  

* HR committee members
* Talent managers
* Inclusion and Care SPOCs in each entity
* Communications
* People Analytics
* HRBPs
* Business leaders and people managers across the organization
* External partners and coalitions
  

(External) English Qualifications:

The experience and skills listed are exhaustive. You do NOT have to match with all of them to apply. Use your judgement* Strategic Leadership: Ability to design and execute global strategies that influence culture and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Change Leadership: Skilled in driving cultural and behavioral change across diverse geographies.
* Data Fluency: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, set KPIs, and communicate insights effectively.
* Inclusive Communication: Ability to communicate across cultures and levels using accessible, inclusive language.
* Intercultural Effectiveness: Curiosity and adaptability to work globally while tailoring approaches to local context.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Proven track record of building partnerships and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.

  

**Experience**  

Demonstrated experience driving transformation and solving complex, ambiguous problems in a global environment with multiple stakeholders, ideally within Inclusion \& Diversity, HR, culture transformation, or an adjacent field such as social impact. Multi\-regional or global experience in complex stakeholder environments is a plus.  

  

**Personal Attributes**  

Commitment to fair change at scale. Cultural agility and openness to diverse perspectives. Resilience and adaptability in a fast\-changing environment.  

  

**Scope Note**  

Disability inclusion and accessibility are managed through a dedicated team; this role partners closely to ensure alignment and avoid gaps.

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Workforce Planning
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.**About the Team**
In the Workday Adaptive Planning team, we help organizations plan, model, and execute their most critical business decisions. Our Workforce Planning products sit at the intersection of Finance and HR, enabling customers to align headcount, skills, cost, and organizational structure with their strategic objectives. Built on a powerful, in\-memory planning platform, our solutions support dynamic, company‑wide planning, rich what‑if modeling, and analytics at scale to help customers navigate ongoing workforce transformation.  

  

The Workforce Planning product area focuses on strategic workforce planning and task intelligence: enabling customers to connect long‑term business strategy to workforce demand and supply, understand the work itself (tasks, roles, and skills), and optimize how that work gets done across people, teams, and time. Capabilities include headcount and cost planning, skills and role\-based planning, task\- and activity\-level modeling, scenario modeling for organizational change, integration with HCM/HRIS and financial systems, and intuitive experiences for HR, finance, and business leaders to collaborate on workforce decisions.  

  

More importantly, we are adding AI/ML product capabilities to new and existing Workforce Planning products. This includes building agents and skills that interpret user inputs and constraints, explain trade\-offs, summarize decision contexts, and generate recommended organizational scenarios. Our goal is to enable business leaders to quickly explore structural options with guidance, rather than just raw tools, so they can focus on driving necessary changes in their organizations.**About the Role**
We are looking for an experienced full\-stack engineer who is proficient in developing scalable and rich web applications to join our growing team. Your primary focus will be to build out scalable and performant backend services and the necessary APIs that will help expedite implementations and improve the user experience for our customers.* Solve hard technical problems with optimism and positivity while also being a great teammate
* Contribute to engineering excellence through effective and fast\-paced Agile development with high bar for quality and best coding practices
* Work with engineering support teams to address customer escalations
* Work with multi\-functional team in designing interfaces
* Write reliable unit, integration, and system level tests that will run on our CI/CD automation pipelines.
* Mentor and learn from other team members through pairing, code reviews, knowledge shares, hackathons, etc.

**About You**
We are seeking an experienced software engineer to collaborate in a fast paced agile environment and open to learning new languages.
Basic Qualification:* 8\+ years experience in software development engineering, architecting, building, and scaling robust and efficient software systems.
* 8\+ experience in object oriented programming languages and technologies (Java, C\#, Python, Scala).
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


Other Qualification:* Team Leadership and/or Agile leadership experience
* Experience with metadata\-driven development, contributing to highly configurable and adaptable platforms
* Experience with integration technologies (e.g., RESTful APIs, message queues)
* Exposure to modern UI technologies and languages (e.g, React, Typescript, JavaScript)
* A deep understanding of software engineering principles (e.g., design patterns, data structures, algorithms) and their application
* A code quality champion and advocate with a strong understanding of test automation principles
* Proven ability to lead Team Collaboration within a software development team and mentor junior engineers.

 **Our Approach to Flexible Work**  

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.  

At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.  

Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.  

In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

description:

**Job Summary:**


As a Human Resources Business Advisor (HRBA) within Asset \& Wealth Management Operations, you will play a crucial role in executing strategic HR priorities and supporting of clients across business. As the primary relationship manager and the face off to the client, this position offers an exciting opportunity to work within a Center of Excellence/Shared Service construct, providing support to senior HR Business Advisors and business leaders on core HR activities. You will help deliver the end\-to\-end Talent Strategy by starting from business problems, curating the right solutions from product offerings, directly informing segmented product strategy, and developing a uniform approach to talent processes.

* Partner with leaders on performance and talent management cycles, including succession planning and promotions.

* Support development and coaching for managers and emerging leaders.

description:
**Profile:**

**Functional Ownership \& Business Partnership:**

* Act as a functional subject matter expert for Oracle HCM Cloud, ensuring system behavior accurately reflects HR business processes.
* Partner closely with HR process leads, HRBPs, Talent, Learning, and Absence stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into scalable system solutions.
* Provide functional guidance and challenge requests where necessary to promote process standardization, data quality, and long term sustainability.

**Requirements, Change \& Governance:**

* Conduct functional business analysis to assess impacts of new requirements, enhancements, and regulatory or organizational changes.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and configuration decisions.
* Contribute to HRIS governance, ensuring changes follow agreed design principles, documentation standards, and approval processes.

**Release \& Testing Management:**

* Contribute to the functional impact analysis for Oracle quarterly releases.
* Define functional test scenarios and coordinate regression testing with HR stakeholders.
* Validate that delivered changes meet business expectations before production deployment.

**Data, Reporting \& Functional Controls:**

* Ensure functional data integrity and consistency across employee, assignment, absence, and talent data.
* Define and validate functional reporting requirements (OTBI, extracts), ensuring outputs align with HR and business needs.

**Stakeholder Enablement \& Support:**

* Support HR users through functional guidance.
* Act as an escalation point for complex functional questions related to Oracle HCM Cloud behavior.
* Contribute to building functional HRIS knowledge across the organization.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Basic requirements (Education, Level of Experience)**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/IT/related engineering.
* Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) are a must.
* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience out of which 4\-6 years in HRIS (Oracle HCM Cloud).
* Experience in a global or multi country HR environment, with understanding of global HR processes and governance, preferably with manufacturing companies.

**Functional \& System Knowledge**

* Strong functional understanding of Oracle HCM Cloud, with hands on experience across the majority of below modules:
* Core HR
* Absence Management
* Talent Management
* Recruiting
* Learning
* Deep understanding of Oracle HCM module interdependencies and end to end HR process flows.
* Experience contributing to functional module implementations, upgrades, and process improvements.
* Exposure to reporting (OTBI, BIP) from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Awareness of Oracle release management, regression testing, and functional troubleshooting.
* Technical knowledge of integration tools or reporting technologies is considered an asset, but not the primary focus of the role.

**Skills**

* Strong functional and business acumen, with the ability to translate HR needs into system configuration decisions.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, able to explain system behavior and design choices to non technical stakeholders.

description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**About the role**

  

As a Talent Acquisition Coordinator at New Relic, you will play a pivotal role in making sure each applicant has a world\-class experience from start to finish. As the primary point of contact for our candidates, you will act as a brand ambassador, demonstrating our values in all of your interactions. As the go\-to person for all things related to scheduling and candidate experience, you will be a close partner with our recruiters, hiring managers, and other members of our TA team. Our dynamic talent acquisition team encourages ambitious ideas. We will look to you and our team of Coordinators to drive and improve our interview process!

  


**Responsibilities:**
* Partner with hiring managers and recruiters to schedule phone and video interviews in a fast\-paced environment.
* Correspond with candidates via Zoom, by email, or over the phone to answer their questions and help them move through the interview process.
* Host candidates during virtual interviews, giving them a window into our extraordinary work environment as you lead them through schedules you've organized
* Post open roles to external job boards as requested.
* Find opportunities to improve our candidate experience and streamline our scheduling process.
* Collaborate with the larger PeopleOps team on projects to improve candidate experience.
* Support recruitment events, meet\-ups, and other talent branding and event needs.

**Requirements:**
* At least 5\+ years of experience in the Recruiting space or similar field.
* Skilled at managing multiple, competing priorities.
* Be unfazed by last\-minute changes and can easily navigate shifting priorities.
* Ability to problem solve and find creative solutions independently and as well as part of a team.
* Excellent and timely communication skills with all collaborators including candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and apply appropriate tact.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Prior scheduling \& calendar management experience.
* Experience with Mac OS, Applicant Tracking Systems and Google Suite.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.



If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.



We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.


**Our hiring process**  

  

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.  

  

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.  

  

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.



New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.



Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.



Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant\-privacy\-policy

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**About H.P. Singh Agencies**

H.P. Singh Agencies is a 50\+ year\-old textile trading and retail house based in Delhi, managing over 80,000 SKUs across cotton, silk, brocade, ikat, linen, and digitally printed fabrics. We serve export houses, fashion designers, boutiques, and walk\-in retail customers from our Nehru Place flagship store, supported by multiple warehouses in Okhla. The company is in the middle of a significant digital transformation — implementing Odoo ERP, CRM systems, and data\-driven operations — and the people function needs to keep pace.

**About the Role**

We have 100\+ employees and zero formal HR infrastructure. No employee handbook. No structured hiring pipeline. No appraisal system. No onboarding process. That is not a problem — it is your mandate.

We are hiring our first dedicated HR Manager to build the entire people function from the ground up. You will not inherit systems to maintain — you will create them. This role reports directly to the Director.

This is not a back\-office admin role. You will sit at the leadership table, influence hiring decisions across every department, and shape the culture of a company that is professionalizing rapidly while staying rooted in its 50\-year legacy. If you are the kind of person who gets energized by a blank canvas and has the discipline to fill it with real, working systems, read on.

**What You Will Build (Key Responsibilities)**

Phase 1 — Foundation (Month 1–3\)

* Conduct a full workforce audit: compile a complete employee master (roles, compensation, documents, statutory compliance status) across all locations
* Assess and close any PF, ESI, and labour law compliance gaps — at 100\+ employees, there is zero room for exposure here
* Establish a basic attendance and leave management system integrated with our existing workflows
* Standardise employment documentation: offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, exit checklists
* Create a clear organogram reflecting actual reporting lines across store, warehouse, and office teams

Phase 2 — Systems (Month 3–6\)

* Design and launch a structured hiring pipeline, with distinct sourcing strategies for blue\-collar roles (warehouse packers, loaders, helpers) and white\-collar roles (merchandisers, sales executives, designers, operations staff)
* Build a proper onboarding programme — a new joiner at HP Singh should be productive and culturally oriented within their first two weeks, not left to figure things out
* Draft and implement the company's first Employee Handbook covering leave policy, code of conduct, working hours, disciplinary procedures, anti\-harassment policy (POSH), and grievance redressal
* Design a practical appraisal framework — simple, transparent, and tied to measurable outcomes, not paperwork for its own sake
* Provide accurate monthly inputs (attendance, deductions, new joiners, exits) to the CA firm handling payroll

Phase 3 — Talent \& Culture (Month 6–12\)

* Own the full recruitment lifecycle for critical hires across departments — from writing the brief, to sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing
* Begin tracking attrition data and conducting structured exit interviews to identify patterns
* Develop a basic training calendar: product knowledge for new warehouse and store staff, soft skills for client\-facing roles, and compliance training
* Conduct a compensation benchmarking exercise — are we paying market rates, and where are we losing people?
* Collaborate with leadership to define HP Singh's employer brand and what makes us a compelling place to work

**Candidate Profile**

Experience: 5–10 years in an HR generalist role. Strong preference for candidates who have been the first or second HR hire at a company and have built processes from zero — not just operated within an existing framework.

Industry Fit: Retail, trading, distribution, textile/apparel, FMCG, or manufacturing backgrounds strongly preferred. You must be equally comfortable managing hiring and compliance for a warehouse floor team as you are recruiting a mid\-level sales or design professional.

Statutory Knowledge: Working knowledge of PF, ESI, Shops \& Establishment Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and POSH compliance. Delhi\-specific labour regulations is a strong plus.

Talent Eye: You do not just fill vacancies — you assess fit. You understand that a great resume does not equal a great hire, and you have the instinct and frameworks to evaluate ownership mindset, cultural alignment, and growth potential alongside technical skills.

Tech Comfort: Proficient with Google Workspace. Experience with HRMS/HRIS platforms (Zoho People, GreytHR, Keka, or similar) is a plus. You will eventually help bring HR data into our Odoo ERP ecosystem.

Personality: Independent, high\-ownership, structured, direct. You are comfortable building in ambiguity, pushing back respectfully when needed, and holding people — at every level — accountable to the systems you create.

**First 90\-Day KPIs**

* Complete employee master audit with 100% documentation across all locations
* Identify and close all critical PF/ESI/statutory compliance gaps
* Publish v1\.0 of the HP Singh Employee Handbook
* Hire at least 2 open positions end\-to\-end using a structured, documented process
* Present a 12\-month HR roadmap to the Director covering systems, hiring, compliance, and culture priorities

**Why This Role Matters**

Job Overview  
A Botanist is a scientist who specializes in the study of plants. This role involves extensive research and experimentation to understand plant life, including their growth, genetic properties, ecological functions, and chemical makeup. Botanists work in various settings, from laboratories and greenhouses to outdoor environments, and often contribute to broader scientific knowledge, agricultural innovations, and conservation efforts. They may work independently or as part of a multidisciplinary team, addressing complex botanical questions and applying their findings to real\-world challenges.

* Conducting field research to collect plant samples and data
* Analyzing plant genetics and conducting laboratory experiments
* Identifying and classifying new plant species
* Studying the effects of environmental changes on plant growth
* Publishing research findings in scientific journals
* Collaborating with other scientists and researchers
* Developing and maintaining botanical gardens or herbariums
* Providing expert advice on plant\-related issues to government and industry
* Teaching botany or related subjects at academic institutions

* Conducting experiments to understand plant diseases and pathogens
* Advising agricultural practices to improve crop yield and sustainability
* Utilizing advanced technologies for plant research such as genomics and molecular biology tools

title: Robotics Annotation
description:
**About Autonex**

Autonex is on a mission to build India’s most impactful deeptech company and become a global leader in applied AI. We’re reimagining how intelligent agents, robots, and automation systems learn, adapt, and operate in the real world.

Our work spans multiple domains from robotics and industrial automation to dental intelligence and autonomous decision\-making. At Autonex, you’ll work on cutting edge problems that push the boundaries of how AI thinks and acts in complex, real world environments.

We’re early. We’re ambitious. And we’re looking for exceptional people who want to learn fast, contribute meaningfully, and grow with us.

**The Role**

As a **Robotics Annotator**, you will be at the core of how our intelligent systems learn, reason, and improve. Your primary responsibility will be to **analyze, evaluate, and annotate the decision making trajectories of AI agents** ensuring that their outputs are accurate, logical, and aligned with intended outcomes.

This role is ideal for detail\-oriented, analytical thinkers who enjoy problem\-solving and want to gain hands\-on exposure to applied AI systems without needing a technical background. You will play a crucial role in improving AI reliability, enhancing real\-world performance, and ensuring that our models deliver measurable impact for clients.

If you love solving complex problems, thinking critically, and building something from 0 → 1 this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Evaluate AI agent trajectories:** Examine the complete sequence of steps taken by AI agents to execute a given task, and determine whether the final output aligns with the prompt or objective.
* **Analyze model reasoning:** Dive deep into the decision making process followed by the agent to identify where it succeeded or failed, understanding the logic behind each action or choice.
* **Identify and classify errors:** Spot incorrect reasoning steps, logic gaps, or decision flaws and categorize them accurately based on defined guidelines.
* **Annotate with precision:** Record success/failure outcomes, mark errors, and input structured feedback on both internal annotation tools and external client platforms.
* **Ensure high\-quality outputs:** Consistently achieve and maintain annotation accuracy above 90%, ensuring that model evaluation data is reliable and actionable.
* **Collaborate with AI operations:** Work closely with internal teams to communicate key findings, share insights from model performance, and help refine training workflows.
* **Work across diverse projects:** Participate in annotation initiatives across multiple AI applications including robotics, industrial IoT systems, healthcare imaging, dental intelligence, and more.

**Who You Are**

* **Analytical and detail\-oriented:** You can follow complex logical processes, spot errors, and think critically about decision making sequences.
* **Curious and driven:** You’re excited to explore how AI agents think, learn, and make decisions and you’re motivated to keep learning.
* **Structured and methodical:** You’re able to follow well defined processes precisely and maintain a high standard of quality over time.
* **Self\-starter:** You thrive in fast paced, high ownership environments and don’t need micromanagement to deliver results.
* **Mission\-aligned:** You’re passionate about building technology that has real world impact.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, or QA processes.
* Familiarity with prompt based AI systems or agent reasoning frameworks.
* Basic exposure to applied AI concepts or quality assurance workflows.

**What You’ll Learn \& Where You’ll Grow**

* How large language models, reasoning agents, and applied AI systems work under the hood.
* How to design, evaluate, and improve agent reasoning in real world use cases.
* How to manage end\-to\-end AI projects from initial training to client delivery.
* How to operate in a high\-growth deeptech startup, wearing multiple hats as we scale.

This role is designed to evolve within 12–18 months, you’ll grow from training AI systems to **managing full\-scale programs**, leading client deployments, and defining product strategy.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a core team building next generation AI systems from the ground up.
* Gain rare, hands\-on experience in how intelligent agents learn, reason, and make decisions.
* Contribute directly to real\-world AI projects across robotics, healthcare, and industrial automation.
* Work in a high\-growth, high\-ownership environment where your work has visible impact.
* Learn deeply about applied AI without needing a technical or coding background.

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking a dedicated and professional IT System Support Position to join our onsite support team. The role requires providing technical support for installed products at premium client sites, including 5\-star and 7\-star hotels. The candidate must demonstrate strong technical expertise, adherence to professional grooming standards, and the ability to work effectively with clients and internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1\) Follow the grooming standards of the assigned site, including dress/uniform, facial grooming, and overall professional appearance.

2\) Report to the assigned site as per the defined roster, adhering to scheduled date and time.

3\) Work in coordination with fellow colleagues and the site IT Manager to execute daily roles and service delivery activities.

4\) Attend to guest calls and resolve product\-related issues within the support scope; escalate to the Centralized Support Desk when required.

5\) Report incidents and requests to the Centralized Support Desk for ticket creation, ensuring each issue is logged with a unique ticket number

6\) Perform mandatory daily health checks on all enabled features, including visited and pre\-arrival rooms, and record them in specified sheets.

7\) Comply with any ad\-hoc requests from the IT Manager or MSR team, and ensure updates are reported to the Centralized Support Desk.

8\) Prepare and submit a daily report (Excel format) of all attended activities, including date and details, to the designated distribution list.

9\) Respond to requests for real\-time feature or hardware testing by arranging room access and executing required checks.

10\) Coordinate with the Inventory department for spare hardware requirements, procurement of parts, and repair of faulty hardware.

11\) Be flexible to support ad\-hoc requests, including visits to multiple sites within a day, to ensure seamless service delivery.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

1\) Strong knowledge of computer hardware and networking.

2\) Working knowledge of Linux operating systems.

title: Monitoring & Technical Assistant
description:
Position Title: Monitoring \& Technical Assistant (MTA)

Location: Nashik / Palghar/ Ahilyanagar/ Raigad

Travel: Regular local field travel, as per project requirements

Reporting To: Field Ecologist – Senior Manager

Employment Type: Full\-time

**Overview** 

The Monitoring \& Technical Assistant will work closely with Field Ecologists, ground teams, and project coordinators to support on\-ground monitoring and implementation activities under the guidance of technical experts. The role includes monitoring plantation/restoration performance (survival and growth), coordinating with nurseries on species availability and stock quality, and supporting technical documentation for field activities. This position requires regular fieldwork, data collection, and coordination with local teams and communities to ensure the smooth implementation of restoration activities and the effective delivery of awareness programs. The assistant will also support baseline and periodic monitoring, including nursery stock verification, plantation audits, basic soil and water observations, photographic documentation, geo\-tagged data collection, and assistance in community outreach and awareness sessions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\) Field Execution, Monitoring, and Data Collection** 

 Conduct regular field visits to the plantation and restoration sites.

 Coordinate and assist with executing pre\- and post\-plantation activities.

 Track sapling survival, growth parameters, and overall plantation health.

 Collect geo\-tagged photographs and record basic field observations for reporting.

 Coordinate with field staff for site access, monitoring schedules, and on\-ground updates.

**2\) Nursery Coordination**

 Support seed collection activities in coordination with local communities.

 Coordinate with nurseries to track plant material availability, quality, and dispatch.

 Maintain nursery status records and support verification of species identity and stock quality.

**3\) Technical and Project Support**

 Support technical fieldwork related to monitoring and documentation.

 Assist in baseline and periodic monitoring as guided by the technical team.

 Support project data compilation, record\-keeping, and reporting.

 Assist in data collection for theme\-based research activities.

**4\) Awareness and Community Engagement** 

 Support planning and execution of awareness/outreach sessions for communities and schools.

 Coordinate logistics for field\-based awareness programs.

 Assist in developing or preparing materials for awareness sessions.

**5\) Coordination and Field Presence** 

 Coordinate site visits with project teams and supervisors.

 Be present in the field on a daily basis, as required by the project.

**6\) Miscellaneous**

 Support field operations and other project\-related tasks as required.

**Eligibility \& Qualifications**

 B.Sc. / M.Sc. (preferably Environmental Science, Forestry, Botany, Biodiversity, or related fields).

 Freshers/newly graduated candidates are encouraged to apply.

 Prior volunteering/internship experience in field\-based projects will be an advantage.

 Comfortable with intensive fieldwork and outdoor conditions.

 Good coordination and communication skills.

 Valid two\-wheeler driving license.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

 Preference for candidates who can independently travel daily to field sites and handle physically demanding outdoor work in forest conditions.

 Strong interest in conservation, monitoring, and community awareness.

 Basic documentation and reporting skills.

 Basic MS\-Office skills.

 Must have two\-wheeler

 **Your attributes and skills:**

  

* You communicate clearly, professionally and service oriented, even in complex situations.

**1\. Hiring Speed \& Quality**

* Time\-to\-hire (target: fast closures)

* Reduction in late coming / absenteeism

**3\. Employee Performance \& Productivity**

* Improve output through basic performance systems

**Success Metrics**

* KPI/KRA implementation across teams
* Performance improvement cases
* Manager feedback

**4\. HR Operations Accuracy**

* Maintain clean, error\-free HR processes

**Success Metrics**

* Accurate employee records
* Payroll input accuracy
* Zero documentation gaps

**5\. Retention \& Work Environment**

* Reduce attrition and maintain team stability

**Success Metrics**

* Attrition rate ↓
* Retention of key employees
* Employee satisfaction (informal feedback)

**6\. Cost Efficiency**

* Manage hiring and HR costs effectively

**Success Metrics**

* Cost per hire
* Minimal dependency on expensive agencies
* Optimized HR processes

**Skills \& Competencies Required**

* Strong hands\-on experience in **recruitment and HR operations**
* Practical knowledge of **HR policies and labour law basics**
* Ability to handle **multiple roles and departments**
* Strong **discipline, control, and execution mindset**
* Good communication and conflict resolution skills
* Proficiency in **Excel, Google Sheets, and basic HRMS tools**

**Preferred Profile**

* Experience in **SME / startup / growing business**
* Comfortable with **both blue\-collar and white\-collar hiring**
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong ownership and problem\-solving attitude

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. **Role Overview**

You will work on real\-time software projects and learn manual testing along with practical AI usage in QA workflows. This includes leveraging AI tools for productivity, debugging, documentation, and improving efficiency.

The role also involves client interaction, documentation, and detailed product testing, making it a well\-rounded QA position.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Understand product requirements and analyze GUI\-based workflows
* Perform thorough manual testing of applications and software products
* Execute test cases and document test results
* Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and test plans
* Perform: Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Integration Testing, UI Testing
* Identify, report, and track bugs and defects effectively
* Interact with clients via chat and calls to understand issues
* Prepare technical and non\-technical documentation
* Conduct research to improve testing accuracy and product understanding
* Collaborate with developers for bug resolution and product improvement
* Use AI tools in daily QA tasks such as testing, reporting, and debugging
* Verify and validate AI\-generated outputs before implementation

**Required Skills \& Abilities**

* Strong analytical thinking and technical mindset
* Ability to understand and test GUI workflows
* Good communication skills for client interaction (chat \& calls)
* Ability to create clear and structured documentation
* Attention to detail and a quality\-focused approach
* Strong problem\-solving skills and learning attitude

**AI Usage Expectation (Mandatory)**

Candidates must understand:

* AI tools are not limited to chatting or prompts
* Ability to explore features, integrations, and workflows
* Apply AI in real tasks such as: Test case creation, Bug analysis, Documentation
* Always validate AI\-generated outputs before use

**AI Productivity \& Development Tools**

● ChatGPT

● Claude

● GitHub Copilot

**Eligibility Criteria**

**Qualification:** B.Tech / BCA / MCA / IT background (or equivalent)

**Experience:** 0\-1 Year (Freshers can apply)

**Preferred:** Basic understanding of software testing concepts

**Working Details**

● Working Days: 5\.5 days a week

● Off: 1st, 3rd, and 5th Saturdays

● Office Timings: 09:30 AM – 06:30 PM

● Shifts: Rotational shifts based on business requirements

**Selection Note**

Candidates may be evaluated based on:

* Practical thinking ability
* Effective use of AI tools
* Attention to detail
* Learning attitude and discipline

**What You Will Get**

* Opportunity to work on real\-time projects
* Exposure to industry\-level QA practices
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted testing workflows
* Guidance from experienced team members
* Performance\-based full\-time opportunity

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Software Tester - Intern (Calicut, Kerala)
description:
**Shipflick** is a logistics technology platform that helps businesses manage shipping, courier

aggregation, order processing, and tracking through a secure, scalable, API\-driven system. We work with modern backend architectures and real\-world logistics workflows.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Software Testing Intern who is eager to learn quality assurance practices

while working on real production systems. The intern will assist in testing web applications, APIs, and end\-to\-end logistics workflows to ensure product reliability and quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand Shipflick’s product features and business workflows
* Perform manual testing of web applications and admin panels
* Test REST APIs (request/response validation, error handling)
* Prepare and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test reports
* Conduct regression testing after fixes and enhancements
* Identify, log, and retest defects using bug\-tracking tools
* Validate order lifecycle flows (order creation, pickup, tracking, delivery)
* Work closely with developers to reproduce and resolve issues

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of software testing fundamentals
* Knowledge of SDLC and STLC
* Familiarity with web applications and validations
* Basic understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, and JSON
* Good analytical skills and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

* Hands\-on exposure to Postman / Swagger
* Basic database knowledge (MySQL)
* Awareness of automation testing concepts

**Eligibility**

* Final\-year students or recent graduates (CS / IT or related fields)
* Freshers interested in a career in Software Testing / QA

**What You Will Gain**

* Real\-time, hands\-on experience in testing a live logistics platform
* Exposure to API and backend systems used in real\-world operations
* Mentorship from experienced engineering professionals
* Stipend of ₹5,000/month during the final 3 months of the 6\-month internship
* Potential full\-time opportunity based on your performance

**How to Apply**

Send us your resume and portfolio at **hr@shipflick.io** or feel free to connect on \+91 73560 97454 or \+91 8891735562

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher, Internship  
Contract length: 6 months

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to complete a 6\-month internship?
* Are you comfortable with the stipend structure of ₹5,000/month for the last 3 months of the internship?
* Are you willing to continue as a full\-time employee after the internship if selected?
* This is a work\-from\-office role based in Eranhipalam, Kozhikode. Are you able to work from the office?

title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:

At Hancod, we’re building Duxbe — an AI\-powered ERP \& POS system designed for small businesses across India and beyond.  
We ship clean UI, fast code, and features that matter. Off\-screen, we smash Jenga blocks, play badminton, and constantly level up.

* Build and maintain complex ERP modules — inventory, accounting, GST, sales, reports.
* Develop in Flutter (web \+ mobile) using Clean Architecture and Riverpod (required).

* Integrate Supabase, Firebase, or REST APIs with performance and security in mind.
* Work closely with backend, QA, and product teams — tight, fast\-moving sprints.

* Basic knowledge of Flutter development, with experience from academic or personal projects.
* Familiarity with ERP or accounting concepts such as ledgers, invoicing, and tax calculations.
* Understanding of Riverpod state management and Clean Architecture principles.
* Experience working with Supabase or similar backend services, including API integration.
* Passion for writing clean, maintainable code and creating simple, user\-friendly UI/UX.

Bonus Points

* FlutterFlow experience (great for rapid MVPs).
* Supabase SQL / Edge Function skills.
* Published apps on Play Store or App Store.
* You debug faster than you text back on WhatsApp.

Culture Fit?

If you…

* Enjoy solving real\-world problems for businesses,
* Take ownership without hand\-holding,

You’ll fit right in. Let’s build something awesome together.

Unpaid Internships are available for fresher

CognoSpace is an activity\-based educational solutions developer that prioritizes **experiential learning**. Our curriculum caters to the entire spectrum of STEAM learning purely through activities. To deliver such a curriculum we partner with schools in creating smart experiential learning labs with modern infrastructure, that includes state\-of\-the\-art Science, Math, Engineering equipment, and technology like AI, Drones, Automation, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, and 3D Designing/Printing.

**About the role:**

**STEM Educator** will play a pivotal role in supporting the operations and activities of CognoSpace at the school, a physical modern **educational space** where high school students engage in **hands\-on science experiments,** and technology\-based learning using **Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality** tools. This individual will provide technical expertise, guidance, and assistance to students in delivering our curriculum, ensuring a safe and productive learning environment. He /She will be responsible for facilitating curriculum execution, and be a **liaison between the company and the school.**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Curriculum Delivery:** End\-to\-end content delivery and classroom management. Assist students in performing science experiments using CognoSpace STEM kits. Ability to use and deliver proprietary AR/VR content, AI topics, Technologies like Drones and IoT, 3D Printing
* **Managing Space:** Be the support in coordinating the entire execution process through maintenance of premises, equipment, educational tools. Collaborate with school staff and management in ensuring smooth execution of the curriculum.
* **Equipment Maintenance:** Regularly inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot lab equipment to ensure safe and optimal functionality. Coordinate repairs or replacements with the product team as needed.
* **Safety and Compliance:** Enforce safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a secure environment for students and promote responsible use of tools and equipment.
* **Resource Management:** Manage and organize the inventory of tools, supplies, and materials in the lab. Maintain accurate records of equipment usage and inventory levels.
* **Documentation and Evaluation:** Maintain comprehensive record of lesson plan execution and outcomes using CognoSpace Mobile App or the web application.
* **School Engagement:** Actively engage with student activities at schools such as parent days, sports days, science fairs, etc. to promote the CognoSpace brand by supporting stalls, workshops and the overall lab program.
* **Feedback:** Evaluate the effectiveness of lab activities and the curriculum. Provide feedback to the CognoSpace product development team and propose improvements.
* **Training (Future proposition):** Take on the role of a trainer to mentor and train new lab specialists, providing guidance on effective support techniques, technical knowledge, best practices and safety protocols.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Prior teaching experience is a plus.
* Experience working in a collaborative environment like laboratories/tinker\-labs/STEM labs/Computer labs lab, laboratory, or science\-related environment is a plus.
* Freshers are encouraged if they come with an Engineering Background
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with students, teachers, parents, and school management.
* Experience in Robotics labs, Makerspace will be a plus.
* Leverage company mobile APP and digital content for end\-to\-end delivery and classroom management.
* Assist students in performing activities using CognoSpace STEM kits, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality \& 3D Printing.
* The Initial salary pay range will be from 3 LPA .

**2\-3 weeks of training will be offered upon joining and before deployment in schools.**

title: QC Executive
description:
Job Title

**Quality Control Executive – Particle Board**

Department

Quality Control / Production

Reporting To

QC Manager / Plant Head

Job Purpose

To ensure particle boards are manufactured as per required quality standards, specifications, and statutory norms through systematic inspection, testing, and process control.

Key Responsibilities1\. Incoming Material Inspection

* Check quality of wood particles, resin, wax, and additives
* Verify moisture content and particle size
* Ensure raw materials meet approved standards

2\. In\-Process Quality Control

* Monitor mat formation, resin distribution, and layer consistency
* Check press parameters (temperature, pressure, press time)
* Ensure thickness and density control during production

3\. Finished Product Inspection

* Inspect boards for surface defects, edge cracks, blisters, and color variation
* Measure thickness, size, and density
* Ensure sanding quality and dimensional accuracy

4\. Laboratory Testing

* Conduct physical and mechanical tests:
* Internal Bond (IB)
* MOR \& MOE
* Screw holding strength
* Thickness swelling \& water absorption
* Maintain test records and reports

5\. Standards \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with **IS 3087 / customer specifications**
* Monitor formaldehyde emission norms (E0/E1/E2 if applicable)

6\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain QC registers, inspection reports, and batch records
* Report deviations and non\-conformities to production team
* Support internal and external audits

7\. Corrective \& Preventive Actions

* Identify quality issues and root causes
* Coordinate with production for corrective actions
* Assist in continuous quality improvement

Qualification

* Diploma / B.Sc / B.Tech (Wood Technology / Mechanical / Production / relevant field)
* Experience in **particle board / plywood / MDF industry** preferred

Experience

* 1–5 years in QC role (freshers with relevant knowledge may apply)

Skills Required

* Knowledge of particle board manufacturing process
* Understanding of IS standards and QC testing methods
* Basic lab testing skills
* Documentation \& reporting
* Attention to detail

**Business Development Representative – US Market (Real Estate \& Architectural Services)**

**Department:** Business Development

**Location:** Mohali, India – Work from Office

**Weekly Offs**: Saturdays/Sundays fixed off \& US Holiday Calendar applicable

**Working Days:** Monday\-Friday

**Position Summary**

Biorev Studios is a global leader in **3D visualization, rendering, virtual reality, and AI\-powered architectural solutions** for the real estate, construction, and design industry. Our clientele includes top US realtors, home builders, developers, and architects who rely on our innovative solutions to market and sell their projects faster and better.

We are looking for a **high\-energy, articulate, and goal\-oriented Business Development Representatives** to handle **outbound calling** for our US client base. You will be responsible for engaging decision\-makers, understanding their needs, presenting our solutions and booking qualified meetings/demos for the sales team.

This is not a routine telecalling role — it’s a **consultative sales position** that requires **research, tailored conversations and relationship\-building skills**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead Prospecting \& Research**

* Use company\-provided databases and online tools (LinkedIn, Zillow, Realtor.com, Houzz, etc.) to identify and qualify US\-based **realtors, home builders, developers, and architects**.
* Segment leads based on priority, geography, and potential revenue value.
* Research each prospect to personalize conversations.

**Outbound Sales Calling \& Engagement**

* Conduct **a high volume of outbound calls daily** to decision\-makers in the US.
* Tailor the pitch based on prospect needs and industry challenges.
* Overcome objections with confidence and product knowledge.

**Appointment \& Demo Booking**

* Secure **qualified meetings/demos** for the senior sales or solutions team.
* Ensure all booked appointments are well\-prepared with lead context and conversation history.

**Follow\-up \& Relationship Building**

* Follow up with warm leads and prospects who have shown interest but not yet converted.
* Nurture long\-term relationships for repeat and referral business.
* Handle re\-engagement calls for dormant leads.

**Data \& CRM Management**

* Log every interaction, call note, and follow\-up task accurately in the CRM.
* Maintain and update lead status to ensure the pipeline is always current.
* Ensure zero lead leakage by following a disciplined call\-back process.

**Collaboration \& Market Intelligence**

* Work closely with the Business Development Manager to align call strategies with company objectives.
* Share market trends, competitor activities, and client feedback for service and pitch improvement.
* Collaborate with marketing for targeted campaigns and follow\-ups.

**KPIs \& Performance Metrics**

* **Daily outbound calls target**.
* **Appointment/demo bookings** per week/month.
* **Conversion ratio** from call to meeting.
* **Lead engagement rate** (how many cold leads moved to warm).
* **CRM accuracy score** (data completeness and follow\-up compliance).

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent spoken English with neutral or US\-accent clarity.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation and active listening skills.
* Confident phone manner with the ability to handle objections and rejections positively.
* Knowledge of time\-zone calling etiquette for US regions.
* Ability to research prospects and personalize conversations.
* Familiarity with real estate or architectural services preferred but not mandatory.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets, and email platforms.
* **AI\-driven approach to sales prospecting** – ability to leverage AI tools for lead research, data enrichment, conversation preparation, and productivity enhancement.
* Comfort in adopting and learning **new AI\-assisted workflows** for outreach and reporting.
* Resilient, self\-motivated, and target\-oriented mindset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Business, Marketing, Communication, or related fields** preferred.
* 1\-5 years of relevant experience in **B2B sales, inside sales or international voice process**.
* Freshers with exceptional communication skills will be considered.

**Why Join Biorev**

* Opportunity to **start a career in project management and client success**
* Exposure to **international clients and global workflows**
* Hands\-on learning environment with **real project responsibility**
* Supportive leadership focused on **growth and skill development**
* Opportunity to develop **operations, coordination, and communication skills**

If you are proactive, structured and passionate about handling Outbound Calling for our US client, apply now.

If you want to move from the lab/field to a platform where your knowledge impacts thousands—read on.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN (THE MISSION):**

* **The Content Engine:** Take full accountability for our educational output. You will define the content mix for B2C (Student Certifications) and B2B (Institutional Knowledge Partners).

* **The Narrative:** Move beyond technical jargon. You will write scripts for videos, design infographics, and author whitepapers that showcase the future of sustainable farming.
* **Academic Liaison:** Act as the technical bridge between Waytoogreen and our university partners (like TNAU), ensuring our platform stays at the cutting edge of research.

**WHO YOU ARE (THE MUST\-HAVES):**

* **Academic Background:** A degree in Agriculture is non\-negotiable. You must know your soil, your crops, and your climate tech.
* **The "Translator" Skill:** You have a rare ability to take a 40\-page research paper and turn it into a 2\-minute video script or a 500\-word blog post.
* **Startup Mindset:** High agency, low ego. You are willing to research the data, write the copy, and help direct the video shoot.

**THE CEO’S WISHLIST (BONUS POINTS):**

* **Native\-level fluency in Tamil** (written and spoken) is a massive advantage.
* Experience in **Agri\-Extension** or **EdTech** content creation.
* A genuine obsession with **Sustainability** and the **Green Economy**.

**WHY JOIN WAYTOOGREEN?**

* **Impact:** Your words will directly contribute to farmer upskilling and the global fight against climate change.
* **Ownership:** You aren't just a writer; you are the "Chief Scholar" of our brand narrative.
* **Growth:** Competitive Salary a front\-row seat in an accelerating Agri\-tech start\-up.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Don't just send a generic resume. Show us your work. Send us a writing sample or a link to a project where you made science look simple.

**Join us in building a greener future at Waytoogreen!**

description:
**!!! IMPORTANT – Please Read Before Applying !!!**

To ensure mutual alignment and commitment, we kindly request that applicants **apply only if they are comfortable with the following conditions**:

* We are specifically looking for interns/candidates who are looking for full\-time \& long\-term opportunities. If your background is primarily in freelancing or part\-time roles, we respectfully ask that you refrain from applying.
* **Human\-Only Content:** This role is for writers who can craft high\-quality content **manually**. We have a **zero\-tolerance policy** for raw AI\-generated content or text spun through paraphrasing tools. We are seeking applicants who can think, research, and write using their own intellect. If you cannot produce 90% to 100% human\-written content without depending on AI, we respectfully ask that you **do not apply**.
* **Time tracking software** will be used to monitor productivity and work hours. Please proceed only if you are comfortable working with third\-party time tracking \& monitoring tools.
* The role involves a **6\-day work week**, with working hours **flexible and customizable** to your convenience (45 to 50 hours per week).
* We are specifically seeking candidates who are **available for at least 6 months (or more)**.
* Candidates who move forward in the hiring process will be required to participate in a **video interview** as part of our evaluation. If you are not comfortable with video interviews, we respectfully request that you **do not apply** for this role.

We appreciate your understanding.

**About the Hiring Company**

Our client is a dynamic and rapidly growing Digital Marketing \& Development Agency offering services across website design, development, SEO, content marketing, social media, and paid campaigns. They are results\-driven, innovative, and work with clients across industries and geographies.

They are now looking to onboard a **Content Writing Intern** who is a wordsmith at heart and possesses the unique ability to blend professional research with a high\-quality human touch.

**Role Overview**

The **Content Writing Intern** will be responsible for crafting high\-quality, professional, and engaging content across a vast array of niches. We are looking for someone who can write from scratch but also understands the modern landscape—meaning you can take AI\-generated drafts and "humanize" them so effectively they achieve a **90\-95% human score** on detection tools.

**Zero Tolerance Policy:** We have a strict policy against raw AI output and plagiarism. If you cannot write original content or manually refine text to perfection without relying on paraphrasing tools, this role is not for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multi\-Niche Writing:** Research and write crisp, professional content for industries including **Health, Tech, Finance, Business, Lifestyle, Real Estate,** and more.
* **Versatile Formats:** Create engaging copy for web pages, blogs, articles, and whitepapers.
* **Content Humanization:** Edit and refine AI\-assisted drafts to ensure they sound 100% natural, authoritative, and pass high\-threshold human\-content detectors.
* **Research:** Conduct deep\-dive internet research to ensure all content is factually accurate and unique.
* **Quality Control:** Ensure all content is easy to understand, non\-repetitive, and grammatically flawless.
* **SEO Integration:** Collaborate with the SEO team to naturally integrate keywords and topics (training provided).

**Requirements**

* **Writing Excellence:** Exceptional command of the English language with a "professional yet accessible" writing style.
* **Research Skills:** Ability to digest complex topics from the internet and reproduce them in your own words.
* **Freshers Welcome:** Open to college students or recent graduates who have the time and dedication to meet the 45\-50 hour weekly requirement.
* **Originality:** Must be able to write without relying on automated paraphrasing tools or "spinners."
* **Bonus Skills:** Familiarity with **WordPress** and basic **Keyword/Topic Research** is a plus (if not, we will train you).
* **Attention to Detail:** Ability to follow strict brand guidelines and technical briefs.

**What’s in it for You**

* **Diverse Exposure:** Work on a wide variety of niches, building a massive and diverse portfolio.
* **Expert Training:** Learn the "science" of content—including SEO writing and advanced WordPress management.
* **Career Path:** Potential for a permanent, full\-time role within a fast\-growing agency based on your performance.
* **Flexibility:** Work on your own schedule within a 6\-day work week structure.

**How to Apply**

If you are passionate about professional writing and content strategy, please share:

* Your **Resume**.
* **Writing Samples** or a portfolio of your work (links or attachments).
* A short note on **how you ensure content sounds "human" and professional.**

 As the primary HR point of contact for these regions, you will manage all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, ensuring compliance with respective local employment laws and fostering a positive work environment. Concurrently, you will act as our L\&D specialist, creating impactful training programs that drive employee growth, support career development, and strengthen our company culture.

 UK \& India HR Management (approx. 50%)
 


* Serve as the first point of contact for all HR\-related inquiries from employees and managers in the UK and India.

* Administer regional payroll and benefits, acting as the liaison with external providers in both countries.

* Bridge cultural, operational, and behavioural differences by facilitating and alignment workshops, communication frameworks, and change engagement initiatives.
* Partner with executive stakeholders to unify teams under a shared identity, shared goals, and common performance standards.



  





 Learning \& Development (approx. 50%)
 


* Design, develop, and execute a global Learning \& Development strategy that aligns with our business objectives and company values.
* Conduct training needs analyses across all departments to identify skills gaps and development opportunities.
* Create and deliver engaging training programs, workshops, and e\-learning content on topics such as leadership, management skills, communication, and professional development.
* Develop clear career pathways and development frameworks to support internal mobility and succession planning.

 Others

Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. This role offers a challenging work environment and excellent opportunities to learn and grow within the technology and human capital function. The candidate will collaborate with key stakeholders to plan and implement talent development strategy for the technology practice. In addition, the role requires the development and generation of strategies to address learning needs for the technology practice, including the introduction of structured programs to onboard new hires and upskill experienced employees. You will also collaborate with technical experts within the organization to ensure learning content is up\-to\-date, relevant, and accurate. The aim is to streamline learning processes, platforms, and practices to enhance learner experience and productivity. The role involves deploying programs and initiatives to address domain, technical and behavioral learning needs. Additionally, you will execute end\-to\-end program management and coordinate vendor management, data analysis, and reporting efforts.
